name: Rescue Alert
notes: No public page describes a customer sign-in or online bill payment for this biller: billing is automatic (card or bank on file) and changes go through customer service by phone. The fleet requires an online account, so the signed-in area, online payment and register flows are a synthetic stand-in (pay_online evidence synthetic); every real route that is phone-only is modelled as an unsupported capability with a customer-facing note. Researched from Rescue Alert's public home, Pricing and Contact pages only (the only login on the site is a distributor login). Pricing page: myConnect mobile rental $44.95 every month, $119.85 every 3 months ($39.95/mo) or $455.40 a year ($37.95/mo); MXD-LTE cellular base rental $42.95/month, $119.85/quarter, $455.40/year; MXD landline base rental $32.95/month, $89.95/quarter, $335.40/year; purchase options: MXD-LTE $299 equipment + $20.95/mo monitoring, MXD $199 + $15.95/mo, or $849 one-time; keysafe $39.99; free gift lock box or second help button on base units. Plan changes are phone-only (inferred), so plans are described in help rather than billing.plans (an unsupported change_plan hides the plan list). Recurring 'every month' plan charges are the only billing documented; no cancellation, autopay, refund or payment-plan policy is published, so those are phone-only (inferred). Contact: toll free 800-688-9576 (24/7), local 801-571-4121, office hours Mon-Fri 8-5, info@rescuealert.com, 10321 South Beckstead Lane, South Jordan, UT 84095.

autopay.note: Rental plans renew automatically each month, quarter or year on the payment method you ordered with. To change it, call Rescue Alert at 800-688-9576.

autopay_cancel.note: Automatic plan renewals cannot be changed online. Call Rescue Alert at 800-688-9576.

cancel_service.note: Service cannot be cancelled online. Call Rescue Alert at 800-688-9576.

change_plan.note: Plan and billing-period changes are made by phone. Call Rescue Alert at 800-688-9576.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not offered online. Call Rescue Alert at 800-688-9576.

help.title: Pricing
paragraphs: myConnect mobile rental: $44.95 every month, $119.85 every 3 months ($39.95 a month) or $455.40 a year ($37.95 a month). MXD-LTE cellular base rental: $42.95 a month, $119.85 a quarter or $455.40 a year. MXD landline base rental: $32.95 a month, $89.95 a quarter or $335.40 a year.

You can also buy the equipment: MXD-LTE for $299 plus $20.95 a month for monitoring, MXD for $199 plus $15.95 a month, or a single $849 payment. Base-unit plans include a free lock box or a second help button. A keysafe for a spare key is $39.99.
Rental plans renew automatically every month, quarter or year depending on the plan you chose.

paragraphs: Call toll free 800-688-9576 (available 24/7) or locally 801-571-4121. Office hours are Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
Email info@rescuealert.com or write to Rescue Alert, 10321 South Beckstead Lane, South Jordan, UT 84095.
